## Biography
Luke Simpson is an 18-year-old aspiring entrepreneur and AI developer based in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. A graduate of Asquith Boys High School, he is developing his skills in artificial intelligence, software development, and technology entrepreneurship through practical experimentation and project building.

Luke is the creator of **Clyra AI**, an ambitious project exploring how multiple AI capabilities can work together in one unified platform. The project’s direction includes AI agents, automation, research, coding, and creative workflows.

His interests include AI agents, software engineering, automation, interface design, and building useful digital products. His journey is driven by a determination to work through challenges, improve his circumstances, strengthen his abilities, and build a meaningful future. He is at an early stage of his development and is focused on turning ideas into working products and learning through hands-on experience.

## Clyra AI
Clyra AI is Luke’s AI workspace project, intended to bring multiple AI capabilities into a connected experience rather than a collection of disconnected tools. Descriptions of its direction represent project goals and concepts; they should not be treated as proof of a commercial launch or completed capabilities unless independently confirmed.
